item.title: High-Resolution 6Li Solid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Reveals Hidden Lithium Dynamics in All-Solid-State Cathodes
item.description:
این مقاله با 6Li NMR حالت جامد، دینامیک پنهان لیتیوم و بی‌نظمی Li/Fe را در کاتد LiFeCl3 باتری تمام‌حالت‌جامد آشکار می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers 6Li solid-state NMR to directly visualize lithium environments in paramagnetic LiFeCl3 cathodes, revealing hidden Li/Fe disorder, reversible intercalation-conversion chemistry, and trace Fe0 degradation. This enables optimized voltage windows achieving 85.9% retention over 500 cycles, establishing lithium-resolved NMR as a powerful platform linking disorder, hidden redox, and reversibility in all-solid-state batteries.
🏷 6Li NMR · all-solid-state battery · LiFeCl3 cathode · lithium dynamics · intercalation-conversion
